items.e: "In the beginning of the King's Will": At the start of the revelation of the King's Will; that is to say, when it arose in the Will of the King to emanate and create the [various] worlds. "Will": meaning ability and desire.

"The lamp of impenetrable darkness carved carvings in the pure supernal light": The hard spark engraved engravings in the supernal light. "Carved carvings": meaning "[it] engraved an engraving", in this context meaning a withdrawal and self-contraction of the light, leaving behind a "vacant space" empty of light, which appeared like an engraving.

[b]Furthermore — from the pleasures of human beings who take pleasure in the sleep of the night, from them go forth a field and fields.[/b] [aramaic] There is yet another way to interpret the verse: that from the pleasures of human beings who take pleasure in the sleep of the night, from them go forth and are born a field and fields. [hebrew]

All of this the Holy One, blessed be He, required to create in the world, and to repair the world through them — that is, all these kelipot mentioned above, and to order the world by means of them. And all of it: the brain (marrow) is within, and several husks (shells) cover the brain. All of this is like the walnut — the kernel at the interior, and many shells surrounding the kernel. And the entire world is in this manner, above and below. All the worlds are in this same pattern — that is, like the walnut: a kernel in the innermost part, and many shells surrounding it, above and below — meaning both in the upper worlds and in this world, as we have written before.

The letter Tav entered and said before Him: "Is it Your will to create the world with me?" The Holy One, Blessed be He, replied: "No, because through you, many righteous people are destined to die." As it is written: "And I will put the mark of the letter Tav on the foreheads of the men" (Ezekiel 9:4). And we were taught that it is written "and from My sanctified ones, it will begin" (Isaiah 10:12), it is not read "from My sanctifiers", but rather "from My sanctified ones", who are the righteous (as stated in Tractate Shabbat, folio 55, etc.). And therefore, the world will not be created with you.

The three letters Shim, Kuf, and Reish entered, etc.: The three letters, Shim, Kuf, and Reish, came, each one on its own. The Holy One, Blessed be He, said to them: "Are you not worthy that the world be created with you?" Because you letters are called "falsehood", and falsehood is not fitting to stand before Me, and I have already explained it.

And the letters Pe, Alef, Tzadi, etc. ascended: And the letters Pe, Alef, Tzadi, and so on, came, until the letters reached the letter Kaf, because when the letter Kaf descended from the crown, the upper and lower worlds trembled, until everything was established in the letter Bet, which is the sign of blessing, and in it the world was perfected and created. And you will find the explanation of this matter earlier (in the introduction to the book Zohar, folio 25, lines 22 to 39, in HaSulam, etc.).

And if you would say that Aleph, etc.: And if you would say that the letter Alef is the head of all the letters, and that the world should have been created with it. And it is answered, so it is, but because it is called "cursed" with it, the world was not created with it. For this reason, despite the fact that the letter Aleph is a superior and secret letter, it was not given a place, that is, power and strength, to the other side, called "cursed". Therefore, the world was not created with it, and the world was perfected with the letter Bet, and with it was created.

"You are our father!", because this world, which is the Point of Zeir Anpin, called "you", was perfected and created in this level, namely, in the sign of blessing, as mentioned earlier that the world was created and perfected in the letter Beth, because it is the sign of blessing, and also man was created in it, in the level of the sign of blessing, and came out into the world. Therefore, the Point is considered from this aspect as the root of man, and we say to it: "You are our father!", that is, You are our root! And what is said that man was also created in the sign of blessing, will be explained later (on page 3, under the title "And with this").

For Abraham did not know us: because although the world is sustained through him, which is Chesed, as it is written, "The world is built with kindness", he did not strive for us as he strove for Ishmael, when he said: "May Ishmael live before you". And Israel did not recognize us: because all the blessings that he was supposed to give to his sons, he left for this level, which is the Nukva, to bless them all. That is, as it is written, "And this is the blessing that their father gave them", which means that the Nukva, called "this", spoke for them, that is, for their benefit, their father, to bless them. And so too in the blessing of Ephraim and Manasseh, he said: "The angel who redeems me from all evil", which is the Nukva, "bless the lads", etc.

You, HaShem, are our father: that is, the Point, as mentioned above, for you are always over us, to bless us and take care of us, like a father who takes care of his children in all that they need. You are our redeemer from the world, your name: for you, that is, the Point, are the redeemer, as he is called, the redeeming angel, and this is our redeemer from the world, your name. Your name is true, which is the Point, called YHVH. We learn that there is no interruption between redemption and prayer, that is, between the blessing "Redeemer of Israel" and the prayer of eighteen blessings, just as there is no interruption between the blessing of the prayer of the hand and the blessing of the prayer of the head. And I have already explained this.And it is found that for this reason, Abraham did not know us.

Explanation of the article: Because it was objected to in the scripture, “And Judah came near to him,” which is apparently unnecessary, since it would have been sufficient to say, “And Judah said to him: My lord!” And Rabbi Elazar began to explain this with the scripture, “For you are our father,” etc. And he first proves that man and the Point of Zeir Anpin are on the same level, meaning on the level of the mercies that are revealed in the illumination of wisdom, since man was created with the name “Arech Apim,” meaning he is patient and does not get angry, so that man can receive the three radical letters of the illumination of wisdom. And so also the world, which is the Point of Zeir Anpin, was created with the letter Bet, meaning a point in its palace, which is the sign of blessing, meaning the beginning of the revelation of the intelligences of the three radical letters of the illumination of wisdom. As mentioned above (Genesis 1, folio 129, line 139 and 140), the Aleph letter of Mercy is "Chayot Temirin," meaning mercies covered with wisdom, and the Bet letter of Mercy is "Chayot Deitgaliin," meaning mercies that are revealed in the illumination of wisdom.

And with this, the verse explains that Israel said to the Point of Zeir Anpin, which is called "you," because you are our father, since you, that is, the Point, are the source of our life and our sustenance in everything we need. You are our redeemer from the world, your name, because you are the redeemer, etc.

For Abraham did not know us, since he did not strive for us, as he strived for Ishmael, who said, "May Ishmael live before you," because Ishmael is circumcised but has not revealed his evil inclination, that he does not continue with the good inclination of wisdom, which is called HaShem, and his circumcision is in emptiness, that is, in the emptiness of wisdom.
And because it is necessary for wisdom, because he is from the part of appearance and below, and does not have, therefore he is considered as waste from the right hand.

However, Abraham is mercy from the right hand, who understands that he does not need wisdom, and therefore he is hidden from wisdom, secretly, because he is an object of mercy, and therefore he prayed more for the mercies that are hidden from wisdom , because towards them is all his desire and longing.
And this explains why he said, "May Ishmael live before you," and he did not say this way about Isaac.
And it is found that for this reason, Abraham did not know us.

Because the understanding of him is not revealed to us. And Israel does not know him, because Israel is the middle line that appears and is above Zeir Anpin, where is the secret of the world that is hidden from the illumination of wisdom, and therefore all the blessings that are needed to bless his children, are directed to this level, that is, to the Point, so that he blesses them, because his children are from the part of appearance and below, which is the world that is revealed in the illumination of wisdom.

And since he is only from the part of the hidden mercies, he could not bless them, and therefore he left the blessing of them to the Point, which is the world that is revealed, and which will bless them.

For Israel does not know our needs to fill them. Therefore, they said to the Point: "You, HaShem, are our father," because you are our redeemer from the world, your name, because you are the redeemer, etc., because redemption can only be achieved through the illumination of wisdom .

And therefore, the Point is called "the redeeming angel" in relation to the children of Israel, and also the foundation of Zeir Anpin, called Joseph, is called redeemer in relation to the Point, because he transmits the illumination of wisdom to the Point .

And this explains why there is no interruption between redemption and prayer, that is, between the foundation and the Point, because we need to unite them. And it also explains why there is no interruption between the prayer of the hand, which is the Point, and the prayer of the head, which is Zeir Anpin.

And with this, the explanation of the verse “And Judah came near to him” is opened to us, because Judah is the Point, meaning the prayer, and Joseph is the redemption, as mentioned above. And the verse tells us that they came close to each other to unite, until Joseph could not contain himself any longer and revealed his identity. And he revealed the illumination of wisdom to his brothers.

Rabbi Yitzchak and Rabbi Yehudah, etc.: Rabbi Yitzchak and Rabbi Yehudah were sitting one night and studying the Torah. Rabbi Yitzchak said to Rabbi Yehudah: "We have already learned that when the Holy One, Blessed Be He, created the world, He made the lower world similar to the upper world, and made everything correspond, so that every part and detail in the lower world has its corresponding root in the upper world, and it is His honor above and below".

Rabbi Yehudah said, etc.: Rabbi Yitzchak, this is certainly so, and He created man above all, because he includes and completes all the details of creation, and this is what is said: "I made the earth and the man upon it I created", "I made the earth", this is certain and does not need to be said. But He tells us, what is the reason I made the earth? Because I created man upon it, because he is the sustainer of the world, and that everything should be a single perfection. In other words, that the purpose of the entire world and its perfection is man.

He began and said: "Thus said God, etc.": I have already explained this verse. But "Thus said God, HaShem, Creator of the heavens and who stretches them out". This is the Holy One, Blessed Be He, above and above, that is, the understanding, which is the Creator of the heavens, which is Zeir Anpin, which the understanding always corrects and improves. In other words, that it inspires him and transmits intelligence to him. "The one who makes the earth and its offspring tremble", this is the Holy Land, the treasure of life, that is, the Point. "The one who gives soul to the people upon it", the earth, which is the Point, gives soul.

Rabbi Yitzchak said, etc.: Rabbi Yitzchak, all of this is above, that is, in the understanding, and he disagrees with Rabbi Yehudah, who said that "the one who gives soul to the people" refers to the Point, because from there, from the understanding, the living soul comes out to this land, which is the Point. And this land receives the soul in order to give to each one, because the river that flows and comes out, which is Zeir Anpin, receives from the understanding and gives and introduces souls into this land, which is the Point, and it receives and gives to each person who merits it.

Zohar Ilana about this, etc.: The radiance of this tree, which is Zeir Ainpin, rises upward to YESHUT and upward to ABA ve IMA. When it rises to YESHUT, which is Bina, its five hundred measures of height are because it receives HGT NH"Y from Bina, whose sefirot are in the secret of the hundred. But it has no foundation, because IMA expands to Hod. And when it rises to ABA ve IMA, which shines with the ancient light, it expands by sixty myriads, because the foundation expands in it and it receives HGT NH"Y from the ancient light, whose sefirot each is one hundred thousand. And therefore, in this tree, there is a light that is Malkut in its body, in which are all the colors, white, red, and green, which are the lights of HGT. These colors rise in direct light and fall in reflected light and are not set anywhere else except on this tree. Because it is the middle line.

When they come out of it, etc.: When the lights come out of it, from the tree, to appear in the non-illuminating radiance, which is Malkut which includes, that from the aspect of Mahazeh and below Zeir Ainpin, in which itself there are ZON, which are the small ZON called Yaacov and Rachel. The lights sometimes settle and sometimes do not settle in it, they are found and they are not found, because they are not established anywhere else except in this tree, which is from the aspect of Mahazeh and above Zeir Ainpin, called Israel. From this tree come out the twelve tribes whose boundaries are in it, which are the twelve lights called twelve diagonal boundaries, which are clearly explained above (see folio 8, and in Parashat Vayechi, folio 46, and all the rest). And they descended in this non-illuminating radiance, to the exile in Egypt in various upper camps. This is what is said, “And these are the names,” etc.

For now it is well understood, that the scripture begins with Israel, that is, "And these are the names of the sons of Israel," because it is that the root of the lights of the twelve tribes come from the tree called Israel, that is, from Mahazeh and above Zeir Ainpin. And so also that which ends with Yaacov, which says, "Those who came from Egypt with Yaacov," because they passed from the aspect of Israel to the aspect of Yaacov, which is from Mahazeh and below Zeir Ainpin, where the twelve lights of the tribes cannot be established, as was said above. And this is "Those who came from Egypt," which is a language of narrowness, and therefore the Egyptians dominated over them. (And see further on, folio 148, and all the rest), where the very reason for the necessity of the exile in Egypt is explained.

What is the reason for “because,” etc.: It is asked, what is the reason? The answer is, because the world stands in His Holy Name. This is what is written, “For in Him was the rock of the worlds created.” Meaning, the Creator of the worlds, for with two letters the worlds were created, this world and the world to come. This world was created with judgment, and it stands, that is, it is sustained, with judgment. As it is written, “In the beginning Elokim created,” where this name refers to judgment. What is the reason? It is so that the sons of men may behave according to judgment, and not stray from the path.

Come and see, it is written, etc.: Come and see, it is written, “And Elokim spoke to Moses.” The name Elokim refers to the severity of judgment that is sustained in Him. What is written above?, “And Moses approached HaShem and said, Adonai.” With the name Adonai, which is the name of royalty. Look at the strength of Moses, who from the beginning of his prophecy did not calm down in this place, which is royalty, and said, “Adonai, why have you done evil to this people? Why have you sent me?” and since I came to speak in your name, evil has not ceased, and you have not saved your people. Who can say such a thing, but Moses, who knew that there was a higher level than royalty, which was for him, because he was the vehicle of Zeir Ainpin, who is the husband of the Matronite?

Rabbi Yitzchak said, etc.: In the beginning, when he was given the house, which is Malchut, since he was the vehicle of Zeir Ainpin, who is the husband of Malchut, it turned out that he merited the level of Malchut to be his house, as is the house of Zeir Ainpin. Therefore, he took care of it, as a man takes care of his house, and says whatever he wants without fear. Moses also did the same; to his house, which is Malchut, he was not afraid.

Another explanation, “And Elokim spoke”: It is the severity of judgment, because the name Elokim is judgment, meaning Malchut, and she said to him, “I am HaShem,” which is another level, meaning Zeir Ainpin, which is mercy, and here all things are united, judgment and mercy together, which is great perfection. This is what is written, “And he said to him, I am HaShem,” which is the measure of mercy. Rabbi Shimon said, if it were written, “And Elokim spoke to Moses, I am HaShem,” it would have said that judgment and mercy are united together for him. But it is not written like that, but rather, “And Elokim spoke to Moses” at the beginning, and then, “And he said to him, I am HaShem,” meaning that they are of a different level than the other, and they are not judgment and mercy united together.

Rabbi Yosi opened, etc.: Rabbi Yosi, “A Psalm of David, HaShem is the owner of the earth and its fullness, the world and its inhabitants.” This land is the Holy Land of Israel, which is destined to be watered by Him, by HaShem, and to be blessed by Him from the beginning, and after that, the entire world will be watered by it. “The world and its inhabitants,” this is the rest of the lands, which drink from Him. Where do we get this from? For it is written, “And He will judge the world in righteousness.”

For He established it upon the seas: These are the seven pillars, which are the seven sefirot of Zeir Ainpin, upon which the earth rests, and they are the seven days and the Sea of ​​Kinneret, which is Malchut, which rules over them. Rabbi Yehuda said: Do not say that it rules over them, for Malchut does not rule over the seven sefirot of Zeir Ainpin, but the Sea of ​​Kinneret is filled with them. For Malchut receives from them. “And He established it upon the rivers”: He asks, who are the rivers? And he answers: Except as it is written, “Let the rivers lift up their voice, let the rivers lift up their waves,” which are the sefirot of Yesod of Zeir Ainpin, which is called a river, as it is written, “And a river flowed out of Eden to water the garden,” and therefore it is written, “And He established it upon the rivers.”

Come and see, this... Come and see, this land which is Malchut, is called when it is Panim ve Panim with Zeir Ainpin, which is called Israel, by the name of Land of Israel. And ask: Jacob, who is Israel, why does he not rule over it like Moses? Is he not also a vehicle for Zeir Ainpin, which is called Israel? For it is written: "And I appeared to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob with El Shaddai," which is the name of the bride before she unites with Zeir Ainpin. (Note: letter 14) And no more.

And from that time... And from that time when Isaac was saved and replaced by the Lamb, the Holy One, Blessed be He, prepared, because of that accuser, that is, Job, his portion. As it is written: "And the queen gave birth... to Uz, her firstborn, etc.", which is Job, who sat in the land of Uz. And this is said immediately after the sacrifice of Isaac. And here, at the birth of Uz, Satan came to take his portion from all the descendants of Abraham, and he did not come near to harm the other side, that is, Israel.

And all came about through judgment... And all is through judgment. As Job judges, so he is judged. For Job was one of Pharaoh's advisors, and when Pharaoh rose up against Israel, he wanted to kill them. He said to him, "No, Job, but take their silver, and subdue their bodies with hard labor, and do not kill them." The Holy One, Blessed be He, said to him, "By your life, with the same judgment with which you have judged Israel, you will be judged." What is written? "But stretch out your hand and touch their flesh, etc." By what he judged Israel, so he himself is judged, and although in other matters he was afraid of the Holy One, Blessed be He. As it is written about him, "And God feared," he did not escape judgment.

Learn what is written... Learn what is written: "But do not touch his soul." For he was given permission to rule over his flesh. For this is the secret of what is written: "The end of all flesh has come before me." And they explained: Before me indeed, that is, the end of all flesh, which is the destructive Satan, came before me to receive permission (as explained in the Parashah of Noah, note 78). And this is what is called "the end of all flesh" and not "the end of all spirit." (As explained in the Parashah of Noah, 130, and see there in the Sulam). And they explained: It is the end that comes from the side of darkness, that is, from the part of judgments of the masculine side, as it is written: "He set an end to darkness, and he examines every limit." And "every limit" is like "all flesh." For there is another end, which is the end on the right, which is holiness, and this that is here is another end on the left, which is darkness. And for this reason he was given permission to harm himself and his flesh.

And you incited me against him to devour him in vain. Ask, if so, was he not punished justly, but because of the word of the accuser who incited and misled him? And answer: But it was all by judgment, and thus Elihu said to him: "For a man is rewarded according to his deeds, and according to the way of a man he shall be repaid." And so it was, as we have said, as he decreed concerning Israel concerning Pharaoh, so it was decreed concerning him.

And this saying, "And you incited me...": And what it says, "And you incited me against him to devour him in vain," the answer is that it is not written "you incited me to devour him," but "you incited me against him." It is against him, in his mind, that he thinks "you incited me," as Job said, "And you have revealed yourself to the counsel of the wicked." Like this, "They entice him with their mouths, and with their tongues they lie to him." And it is also difficult, is it even possible to seduce the Holy One, Blessed be He? Rather, it is not written that "they entice him" and "they lie to him," but "they entice him with their mouths." This matter is about his mouth, that he is seduced. That is to say, they think this way, but in truth it is not so.
And he said to her, "Peace be to you, peace to your husband, etc.": Hence, she is the housewife, and her peace preceded her husband's peace. And not only that, but
she went after him, after the prophet, and not her husband. And Gehazi approached to separate them. This has already been explained.

And the man of God said, etc.: Question: What is the change here that Scripture called him "man of God," and when he was in the city he was called Elisha? And he answers: But here he is certainly the man of God, because this is his place, and not in the city, and not at the time when the sons of the prophets were before him. And that is why he was not called "man of God" but Elisha.

And HaShem hid it from me, etc.: It is like what is written: "And HaShem made it rain on Sodom, etc.", where "HaShem" means: He and His heavenly court, and this is the lower court, that is, Malchut. "And He did not tell me," asks: What is the reason why Elisha did not know? And it answers: But the Holy One, Blessed be He, said: "And how can I kill him, if I tell him, 'He will not die'? For he is a gift from Him, and he will pray for him, and they will not allow him to die." And he must certainly die, because we learned that it is written: "You embrace a son and he connects with the feminine place," and from the feminine place death is caused. And that is why He did not tell him.

And she said to Gehazi, "Gird up your loins, etc." And they explained that the miracle departed from him, since he was not worthy of it. "As surely as the Lord lives and as surely as you live, if I let you go." Question: Why did she insist so much that he go himself, since Gehazi was going? And the answer: Rather, she knew the ways of that wicked Gehazi, that he was not worthy of having a miracle performed by him.

And he placed his mouth upon his mouth, etc.: Ask why he did this. And answer: But Elisha looked and knew that this place, the female, in which he was now bound, was what had caused his death, and upon him he placed his mouth upon his mouth and his eyes upon his eyes to bind him in another superior place, that is, in the place of the male, the place where life is found.

And he placed his mouth upon his mouth, etc.: Ask why he did this. And answer: But Elisha looked and knew that this place, the female, in which he was now bound, was what had caused his death, and upon him he placed his mouth upon his mouth and his eyes upon his eyes to bind him in another superior place, that is, in the place of the male, the place where life is found.

And Jethro, priest of Midian, heard… Rabbi Jezekiah began and said, “And Aaron lifted up his hand.” It is written “hand” without the letter Yud, which means a single hand. And this is because it is necessary to lift the right hand over the left. And we have already explained the secret.

I found in the Book of King Solomon that anyone who raises their hands upward, and is not in prayer and supplication, is a person who has been cursed by ten rulers. These ten rulers were in the city. They are the ten who oversee those who extend their hands upward to receive a prayer or a blessing, and they empower them to honor the Holy Name, and they are blessed below. Once they are blessed below by extending their hands upward, then they are blessed above and honored on all sides.
And these ten appointed ones are ready to receive blessings from above and pour them down, and to bless the one who blesses them. As it is written: "And I will bless them."

For this reason he will be preserved...: Therefore, human beings must be careful when they raise their hands upward, whether in prayer, blessing, or supplication, and not raise their hands in vain, because these ten guardians are ready and awaken at the outstretched hands, and if it is in vain, these ten will curse him with 248 curses. And this is what is written: "He loved the curse, and it came upon him."

And then the spirit of impurity dwells upon those hands, for its path is to reside in an empty place. And blessing does not dwell in an empty place, and that is why it is written: "I lifted up my hands to HaShem, to the Most High," which is translated as "in His shadow," that is, in prayer.

And in that extension of the hands lie lofty secrets. The moment they are extended and raised upward, the person honors the Holy One, Blessed be He, with various lofty secrets, and is worthy to unite the secret of the ten expressions, to unify all and bless the Holy Name as it should be. And he is worthy to unite the secret of the inner Merkavot (Chariots) of Atzilut, and the outer Merkavot outside of Atzilut, so that the Holy Name may be blessed on all sides and all may be unified as one, above and below.

He opened it and said, "And they will not see my face empty." This is the secret of raising the fingers: when a person raises them, they should not raise them empty, but with prayer, supplication, and blessings. And regarding this, "and they will not see my face empty," and "they will not see before me," it is not written, but "my face," which is the secret of raising the fingers: they should not be raised in vain. As we said.

And he spoke, etc., and they took for me an offering, etc.: Rabbi Chaya began, for Jacob chose for Himself, HaShem, the jewel of Israel. How beloved are the children of Israel before the Holy One, Blessed be He! Who desired in them and desired to unite with them and connect with them, and made them a unique people in the world, as it is written: "And who is like your people, Israel, a unique nation on earth?" And they desired in Him and connected with Him. This is what is said: "For Jacob chose for Himself HaShem," and it is written: "For HaShem has a portion with them." And He gave to the other nations princes to rule over them, and He took for His portion Israel.

Rabbi Shimon began: “Who is this who appears like the dawn, beautiful?” Who is this? It is the secret of the two worlds that unite together, and this is the world and the world. That is, this is what is written: “From the world to the world,” which are Bina and Malchut. “Who is it?” behold, we have established that it is a higher degree, the beginning that remains in the question, and it is called “Who is it?” which is Bina, as it is mentioned: “Lift up your eyes on high and see who created this.” (As mentioned above in the Hakdamat HaZohar, folio 8, in the part of “Leila”) “This” is a lower degree, it is the lower world, which is Malchut. And both are two worlds in one union, in one bond, together. And this is through the elevation of Malchut to Bina, because by this she attained the intelligence of Bina. As it is mentioned there.

She who appears, when they unite, etc.: She who appears, meaning when both of them unite as one, Malchut appears like the dawn, meaning when the dawn wants to shine, and then she is beautiful like the moon, Malchut shines like the moon, because the light of the sun, which is Zeir Anpin, shines in her. And then, she shines like the sun, like the light of the sun, when the moon is full, meaning when Malchut is face to face with Zeir Anpin, called the sun. Her beauty is like that of a cloud, because she is strong to protect everything, because then she has perfection and strength to do exploits.

And Malchut receives strength from the upper world, etc.: And Malchut receives strength, meaning Mochin, from the upper world, which is Bina, through Yaacov, a perfect man, who united both, because through the elevation of MAN, Malchut rose to Bina, and they united with each other. He united both above, because Bina received the form of Malchut, and this is Leah. And he united both below, because Malchut acquired the form of Bina, and this is Rachel. And from there came the 12 holy tribes, similar to those above. That is, like the 12 perspectives that are in Malchut above. Yaacov, who was perfect, brought love to both worlds, as We have established, because he married the two sisters, Leah and Rachel, who are Bina and Malchut, two worlds. The other sons of Adam who do this, reveal nakedness above and below, and cause hatred in the two worlds, and cause separation between Zeir Anpin and Leah, and between Zeir Anpin and Rachel, because the union above is with Leah, and the union below is with Rachel. This is what is said: "You shall not take a wife together with her sister for rivalry." They became rivals and filled with hatred towards each other.

And so it is, even Yaacov, etc.: And despite everything, even Yaacov did not complete them properly, the other children of the world cause hatred and separation, and they reveal the nakedness above and below. For in this secret there is a secret of nakedness, meaning the nakedness of the mother and the daughter, who are Bina and Malchut, and everything, they are two sisters and also mother and daughter, it is one secret, because they are called sisters because they are in sisterhood, love, and union of desire. And they are also called mother and daughter, because Bina is called mother and Malchut her daughter. Whoever reveals their nakedness, meaning the judgments that are in them, has no part in the next world, which is Bina, and has no part in faith, which is Malchut.

Rabbi Shimon said: Behold, we have learned that when the Holy One, Blessed be He, created the world, which is Malchut, He engraved in its engravings the secret of faith, which is Malchut, within the lights that are the secret of the upper ones, meaning that the Holy One, Blessed be He, which is Bina, elevated to Himself the faith, which is Malchut, and engraved with the engravings of faith within the lights of His own upper essence, from which Bina and the TuM of Bina came out and descended to the level below her, and there remained in Bina only the crown and the wisdom of the vessels in the lights of the wind nefesh, that this is examined as an engraving in the lights of Him. And He engraved above, in Bina, and He engraved below, in Malchut, meaning that afterwards Malchut also received that mentioned engraving that was made in Bina. And everything is one secret, because the recording of Malchut was in a single form with the recording of Bina, in the secret of the recordings of the Holy Name, which governs with His letters above and below, meaning in Bina and Malchut, which are HaShem the first and HaShem the last of the Name, which are both one single form, which is HaShem. And in this secret, the worlds were perfected, the upper world, which is Bina, and the lower world, which is Malchut.

And this light, which is very subtle, closed due to lack of mercy, was maintained and perfected in him by the middle line, the six extensions, which are the six letters of wisdom, which are not known, that is, they are not revealed to illuminate, except when the thin light of ABA and IMA is hidden, because then the very subtle light illuminates with its illumination. Explanation: Because the illumination of wisdom does not illuminate except at the point of the Shuruk at the time of the elevation of the three points, Holam, Shuruk and Hirik, one after the other, (as explained in Shlach, 39, "VeG") and at the moment when it illuminates the point of the Shuruk, the light of mercy of ABA and IMA is closed, (as explained above in Bereshit, 13, "UveTeda", and see in the introduction to the Book of Zohar, folio 17, "Kayema") it is found that the very subtle light illuminates only at the time of the concealment of the thin light.

And they shall take for Me an offering: Rabbi Yehuda began, "What is Your great goodness that You have concealed from those who fear You, and have done for those who take refuge in You?" (Psalms 31:20). This verse they established and learned, but this secret was established by the Holy Light within the secrets of the upper ones.

And you shall command, etc.: And you shall draw near, etc.: Rabbi Chaiya said, what is the difference here from all the other places, that it is written, “and you shall draw near to Him”? “And you shall speak to all the wise-hearted, and you shall command the children of Israel, and you shall take for yourself spices.” That it is not written as in all the other places, “and you shall draw near,” “and you shall speak,” “and you shall command,” “and you shall take.” And he answers, but it is all in a higher secret, in order to include with it the Shechinah. For the Shechinah is called “you,” and when it is written “and you,” this is in order to include with it the Shechinah in the commandment and in the word, etc.

Rabbi Yitzchak said, etc.: The Ari, the upper light, which is Zeir Anpin, and the lower light, which is the Nukva, are united together in the word “and you,” because “and you” is the name of the Nukva, as mentioned. And the additional letter Vav is Zeir Anpin. As you say, “and you give life to all,” which surrounds Zeir Anpin and the Nukva. And therefore it is not written, “and you shall approach Aaron, your brother,” and “and you shall command the children of Israel,” and “and you shall speak to all who are wise in heart.” This is because at that time, the sun, which is Zeir Anpin, was on the moon, which is the Nukva, and everything was united as one, meaning Zeir Anpin and the Nukva, to serve in the craft of the work. And therefore it is written in them “and you,” who rules over Zeir Anpin and the Nukva. Rabbi Eleazar said, from this it is understood that the Shechinah was over the craftsmanship of the work of the Mishkan, as it is said, "that HaShem gave wisdom and understanding in it."

Rabbi Shimon said, etc.: From this it is understood that Zeir Anpin and the Nukva were over the craftsmanship of the work of the Mishkan. As it is written, “and you shall speak to all the wise in heart, whom I have filled with the spirit of wisdom.” It would have been necessary to say “those whom I have filled,” in plural language, if He were surrounding the wise in heart, but “those whom I have filled” surrounds the heart, which is the Shechinah which is called the heart. As it is written, “and the spirit of HaShem, the spirit of wisdom, shall rest upon it, etc.” And therefore it is necessary to say, “to those whom I have filled with the spirit of wisdom,” in order to teach that the sun, which is Zeir Anpin, is above the moon, which is the Nukva called the heart, in the perfection of everything, and therefore everything was recorded, that is, Zeir Anpin and the Nukva, in all places, in the work of the Mishkan, as it is written in them, “and you,” which alludes to Zeir Anpin and the Nukva. Rabbi Eleazar said to him, if so, these “and you” and “and you,” how do they fit into the continuation of the scriptures, if we explain their meaning about Zeir Anpin and the Nukva?

Rashbi said to him, all of them fit together, “and you will draw near to Him,” his explanation is that he told Moses to draw near to “and you,” which is Zeir Anpin, and the Nukva to Aaron, which is to unite and draw near in him the secret of the Holy Name, “and you,” as it should be. And in this way, “and you will speak to all the wise-hearted,” his explanation is that he will speak and draw near and unite the Name, “and you,” which is ZON, to all the wise-hearted. This is because all of them did not come to do the work of the Mishkan, until the spirit of holiness spoke in them, and whispered to them secretly how to do it, and then they did the work. And in this way, “and you will command the children of Israel,” which is the spirit of holiness, alluded to in the Name, “and you,” which will command the children of Israel, and clarify for them, so that they do the work with complete desire. And so also, “and you shall take for yourself,” its explanation is as We have established. And so also, “and you shall draw near,” and so also all these “and you,” written here in the work of the Mishkan, that everything was done in the secret of this Name, “and you.”

Rabbi Shimon began and said, “And you, O HaShem, do not turn away, my strength, to help me, O who sees.” “And you, O HaShem,” who are the Nukva and the Name HaShem, is Zeir Anpin, a prayer is made so that everything may be one, so that they may be united with one another. “Do not turn away,” its explanation is that it does not turn away to separate itself from him, because the upper light, Zeir Anpin, does not separate from the lower light, the Nukva, because when the upper light separates from the lower light, then all the light is darkened and is not found in the world. Because the world only receives from the Malchut, which is the lower light, and if the upper light, which is Zeir Anpin, does not shine in it, it has nothing to shine in this world.

And therefore it was destroyed, etc.: And therefore the Temple was destroyed in the days of Jeremiah, meaning that Zeir Anpin was separated from Malchut, and although it was rebuilt later in the Second Temple, the light did not return to its proper place. And therefore the name of the prophet who prophesied about this is Jeremiah, which are the letters, “Yarom Yah,” meaning the separation of the upper light upward, from Malchut, and it did not return to shine afterwards as it should in the Second Temple. The name Jeremiah teaches that the upper light was separated from Malchut, and did not return to its proper place, and the Temple was destroyed and the lights were darkened.

**But the name of Isaiah, etc.:** But Isaiah, the name, which are the letters [of] ** yesha Yahu [the Lord will save]**, causes salvation and the bringing back of the supernal light to its place, to Kingship [ Malkhut ], and the building of the Temple, and that all of the lights will return as at the beginning. And therefore, the names of these two prophets stood one against the other; the name of one being** yarum Yahu ** [the Lord will go away], and the name of the other being the opposite ** yesha Yahu **. And the combination of these letters and those letters cause an event according to their meaning, whether for the good or for the bad. And based on this secret — being the combination of the letters of holy names, and also the letters on their own — they cause the occurrence of supernal secrets according to the meaning of the name. For the letters themselves cause supernal holy secrets to occur though them.

The first secret is the Yod of HaShem, which is the first point, meaning wisdom, which is supported by ten pillars that support it. And they are supported by the four directions of the world, south, north, east and west, which are the three axes and the Malchut. As the end of thought, the last point, which is the Malchut, is supported by the four directions of the world, which are south, north, east and west, which are the three axes and the Malchut that receives them, and they are equal to each other, except that the upper point, which is the Yod of HaShem, is masculine, and the last point, which is the Malchut, is feminine.

And this Yod, which is wisdom, remains without a body, meaning it does not have a vessel, because there are only three vessels: Bina, Tiferet, and Malchut, and wisdom does not have a vessel, but is clothed within Bina, Tiferet, and Malchut. And when it is clothed, meaning when it is clothed in them, it is supported by ten pillars, which are HaBaD, HaGaT, NHY, in the secret of the letter Mem without rounding. And although the letter Samech is rounded and is supported by the rounded, the Yod of HaShem, Samech, Vav, and the first Hey of HaShem, Mem (as explained in the offering, letter 22), but in the secret of the letters engraved in dots, meaning in the letters that allude to the characteristic of wisdom called dots, it is examined that the lights above are square, and those below are round.

This square is here, etc.: This square is held in the measure of three points, three on each side. And they are in the measure of the calculation of eight points and there are nine points. And it is explained, and these are the ones that are held and come out of the secret of the light, which is Bina de Arich Anpin, and the crown of ten, which is ABA ve IMA in a square, meaning the letter Mem in a square with ten columns for the letter Yud, which is a single point of them, meaning HaBaD, HaGaT, NHY, which are nine. And there are eight in the secret of the letter Mem in a square, three on each side, when one does not count the Yud itself. That is, Bina, Daat, HaGaT, NHY.

And this is the secret, etc.: And it is explained further, and it is said, and this is the secret. For the letter Yud is a single point, and although it is a single point, its shape is head upwards. Which is the upper point of the Yud, and a point downwards, and the body of the point, and therefore its measurement is three points as • • • in the secret of the right, the left, and the middle, which are the three axes, and therefore the expansion to the four sides, three on each side, is ten with the Yud, and is eight without the Yud itself. As explained above.

Explanation: For there are in the Yud, head, interior, and end, which are the upper point and the lower point and the point itself, which are the three axes that are in it, because the head and the interior of it are two axes, right and left, and the end of it is the middle line. And they are included in one another, and it is found that there are in the head of the Yud three axes, and in the interior of the Yud three axes, and in the end of it three axes, and the three axes that are in the head are HaBaD, and the three axes that are in the interior are HaGaT, and the three axes that are in the end are NeHY. And all of them are squared in the secret of the letter Mem de Tzelem, meaning that the middle line, which is in the head and inside and at the end, is divided into two characteristics, mercy and strength, meaning Zeir Ainpin and Malchut, so that in every three axes there are four directions, two axes right and left are south and north, and the two characteristics that are in the middle line are east and west, because Zeir Ainpin is east and Malchut is west. And it is said (later, letter 18), "when two expand, they become three," meaning when the two axes right and left expand, three axes become, right, left and middle, one becomes two, and the one, which is the middle line, becomes two, meaning two characteristics, which are Zeir Ainpin and Malchut, which are east and west, as explained.

And this is what is said here, and about this it is expanded in the four directions, three on each side, which are nine and there are eight, because the three axes expand in the four directions, south, north, east and west, in the secret of the letter Mem, and it is found that there are in the Yud three of the type of the letter Mem at the head, which are the three axes of HaBaD, the letter Mem inside, which are the three axes of HaGaT, and the letter Mem at the end, which are the three axes of NHY. And it is said “three on each side,” meaning for the three directions that are in the Yud, there are in each of them three on each side. And “direction” refers to a characteristic, as is explained in many places in the Zohar. And “there are nine,” meaning with the essence of the characteristic of the Yud, which is wisdom. And “there are eight,” without the Yud, as explained above.

And these are the ones that are supported, etc.: And these are the eight points that are the columns that come out of the secret of the light, which is Bina de Arich Anpin and the crown of ABA ve IMA, to support the letter Yud, because the Yud is clothed with these eight points, which are Bina, Daat, HaGaT, NHY, and they are called her chariot. And they are not called by their name, but in the secret of the ten points that are in the Torah. Which are, Kamatz, Patach, Tzere, they are Gadar. Segol, which is in Holam, is HaGaT. Hirik, Kubutz, Shuruk, also called Hirik, Shuruk, Malafus, are NHY. Because the spheres of wisdom are called points.

And in the secret of the Book of Adam, etc.: And in the secret of his book, these ten that are nine are divided, in the combinations of the letters of the Holy Name. For understanding and knowledge illuminate the first Hey of HaShem. And HaGaT, NeHY illuminate the Vav of HaShem. And the crown of Yesod illuminates the last Hey of HaShem. In order to unite them and bring them together in all these ways, because when these eight points that are ten move, that is, when they illuminate their light in the path of the three axes one after the other, (as explained above in chapter 39 of the section of Shlah), they illuminate in the light of the letter Mem in square, and they emit eight lights that look like nine, and they are divided downwards, between the spheres of Bina, Zeir Ainpin and Malchut, as explained above, to the point of supporting the entire Mishkan, which is Malchut. Because the wisdom that is in the hand of HaShem is not revealed in all spheres but only in Malchut (as explained above in chapter 276 of the section of Beit Aleph), and therefore, the eight points need to expand up to Malchut, called Mishkan, where wisdom is revealed.

**It is written (Exodus 34:17), "You must not make molten gods for yourselves":** And it is written after it (Exodus 34:18), "You shall observe the Feast of Matzot." [The Zohar] asks, "Why is this next to this?" And it answers, "Rather, this is why He positioned it [so] - one who eats chametz is like one who worships idolatry.

A song, a psalm: Here too, it is said "a song, a psalm" because it is distinguished from other songs. A song of the Holy One, Blessed Be He, which the sons of Korach sang about those who sit at the gate of Gehenna. And who are the sons of Korach? They are the brothers of those who sit at the gate of Gehenna. As our sages said, concerning what is written: "And the sons of Korach did not die," that a place was reserved for them in Gehenna (Megilah 14). And that is why this song is said on the second day in the Temple. I approached them and said: What are you doing in this place? They said to me: We are merchants, and twice a week we separate from the city and occupy ourselves with the Torah. For in the city, people bother us every day and do not let us occupy ourselves with the Torah. I said to them: Happy is your lot.

They opened and said, etc.: They also opened and said: At every time the righteous depart from the world, judgments depart from the world, and the death of the righteous atones for the sins of the generation. And that is why we read the section of the sons of Aaron on Yom Kippur, so that it may be atonement for the sins of Israel. The Holy One, Blessed Be He, said: Seek the death of these righteous, and it shall be reckoned to you as if you were offering sacrifices on this day to atone for yourselves. We learned that as long as Israel is in exile and is unable to offer sacrifices on this day, and is unable to offer the two goats, they shall have the remembrance of the two sons of Aaron, and atonement shall be made for them.

For thus we learned, etc.: For thus we learned, that it is written: "And these are the names of the sons of Aaron, the priests, etc.." And it is written: "The firstborn Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar." It is asked: Why does it say "Eleazar and Ithamar" instead of just saying "and Eleazar and Ithamar," as it says "and Abihu"? Why is the conjunction "and" missing in Eleazar? And it is answered: But Abihu was equivalent to his two brothers together. And the meaning of the verse is: "And Abihu" is like "Eleazar and Ithamar." And Nadab was equivalent to all of them together.

And there are those who teach, etc.: And there are those who teach thus. "The firstborn Nadab" is by himself, and "Abihu" is by himself. And then "Eleazar and Ithamar" are called together, to teach that each of Nadab and Abihu is considered in the eyes of Scripture as both, like Eleazar and Ithamar together. But Nadab and Abihu, both by themselves, are equivalent to seventy sanhedrins who served before Moses. And because of this, their death atones for Israel. And because of this, it is written: "And your brothers, the whole house of Israel, will mourn over the burning." And Rabbi Shimon said: This is why Scripture emphasizes "the firstborn Nadab," that is, the one who had all the merit and greatness. Nadab and Abihu together, how much more! For there were not two like them in Israel.

And he spoke, etc., after the death of Aaron's two sons: Rabbi Hizkiyah began and said: "Therefore, thus says HaShem to the house of Jacob, which redeemed Abraham, etc.". This verse is difficult, because it should have read: "Therefore, thus says HaShem, which redeemed Abraham." What does "thus says HaShem to the house of Jacob, which redeemed Abraham" mean?

But they have already established it, etc.: But they have already established it and we have already learned that Jacob certainly redeemed Abraham. For at that hour in which Abraham fell into the fiery furnace of the Chaldeans, they judged him before the Holy One, Blessed Be He, saying: By what merit will this man be saved? He has no merit of fathers. The Holy One, Blessed Be He, said to the heavenly tribunal: He will be saved by the merit of his sons. For we have already learned that a son justifies his father. They said: But Ishmael came out of him. The Holy One, Blessed Be He, said: But Isaac came out of him, who offered his neck to be sacrificed on the altar. They said: But Esau came out of Isaac. The Holy One, Blessed Be He, said: But Jacob came out of him, who is a complete throne, and all his sons are complete before Me. They said: Surely by the merit of this one will Abraham be saved. This is what the Scripture says: "Who redeemed Abraham."

Rabbi Yitzchak said, etc.: Happy is the fate of this people, that their Lord said to them: "My people, what have I done to you and how have I weary you?" What did Balak, king of Moab, advise? That is, how many things and actions he thought of to destroy you from the world, and how many spells he cast against you.

Rabbi Yosi said, etc.: Rabbi Yosi said, the Holy One, Blessed be He, said to Israel: "Remember now." Alas! We cry out every day and lament and weep: "Remember, HaShem, what has happened to us." "Remember, HaShem, the children of Edom." And He does not want to pay attention to us. And it is because He insistently told us "Remember now." Because "Na" is a language of petition, and we do not pay attention to it, that is why we cry something similar: "Remember, HaShem, what has happened to us." "Remember, HaShem, the children of Edom." "Remember the congregation that You acquired from the beginning." "Remember me, HaShem, with the day of the good pleasure of Your people." And He does not want to pay attention to us.

Rabbi Yehuda said, etc.: Certainly the Holy One, Blessed Be He, always watches over us and remembers us. And if He did not watch over Israel and remember us, we would not be able to survive even one day in exile. This is what Scripture says: "And even this, while they are in the land of their enemies, etc.." For the Holy One, Blessed Be He, does not deal with us according to our works.

And although Balaam was a sorcerer, etc.: And although Balaam was the greatest sorcerer of all the sorcerers of the world, Balak was a greater sorcerer than he. For Balak was great in magic, more than the wise men. And Balaam was great in serpents. Magic and serpents are two levels. Magic depends on action. The serpent does not depend on action, but on the look. And with the word of the mouth, then the spirit of impurity is stirred up upon them to clothe itself in them, and it does what it does.

And Israel Kadoshin Lao, etc.: And the holy Israelites are not like that, but all are holy, and all their actions are to awaken upon them Ruach HaKodesh. As it is written, "Until the Ruach of Marom is poured out upon us." Therefore, as it is written: "For there is no omens in Jacob nor divination in Israel." For Israel is bound to the side of supreme holiness, and their actions come from holiness, and holiness is awakened upon them and clothed in them.

And the wise men in divination, etc.: Come and observe, in divination, Bilak was greater than all the wise men, and Bil'am was skilled in omens. And therefore, when Bilak wanted to join him, what is written? "And the elders of Moab and the elders of Midian went with the instruments of divination in their hands." Come and observe, in the speech of his mouth, Bilam was greater than all the sorcerers of the world, and by observing that augury, he knew how to direct the hour to curse, and therefore his curses were fulfilled. And therefore, Bilak wanted to complete the matter with divination and omens, for therefore he joined him.

HaShem said, etc.: The Holy One, Blessed be He, said to him: "Evil one, my sons have preceded you." There is an act between them, that all the evil sides and the wicked classes and all the sorceries of the world cannot approach them, for they all flee before it. And what is it? It is the tent of meeting and the sacred utensils and the implements of the Temple, and the incense of the spices that nullifies all anger and fury of the world above and below, and the sacrifices and offerings each day, and the two altars for performing the service of the altars, and the table, and the shewbread, and the laver and its stand. And there are many implements for the act, from the aspect of speech of the mouth, which are the ark, and the two tablets of the Torah, and Aaron who atoned for the people each day with prayer. When that wicked one looked at it, he said: "Because there are no omens in Jacob nor divination in Israel." What is the reason? It is because HaShem his God is with him and the king's cry is in him.

And therefore, my people remember, etc.: And therefore, said the Holy One, Blessed be He: "My people, remember, please," I ask you to remember the time when Bilak and Bil'am joined together to destroy you, and they could not, because I upheld you as a father upholds his child and does not leave it in the hand of another. From Shittim to Gilgal, what is the relationship between this and that? And he answers: But the Holy One, Blessed be He, said to Israel: "Please remember," all the time that you were united to me, that wicked one could not with his sorceries and auguries dominate over you. When you stopped supporting me, and were at Shittim, what is written? "And the people ate and worshipped their gods." And at Gilgal, as our sages say: "At Gilgal they sacrificed bulls." And then your enemies dominated you. And all this for what? To know the justices of HaShem, that is, all these justices that I did with you in the time that you were united to me and I did not let anything in the world dominate you, and the wrath from above and below, and the evil classes could not come near you.

And he said to them, "Spend the night here," etc.: Come and see, at the hour when the sun sets and all the doors are shut, and night comes and it becomes dark. How many groups break free from their chains and go and roam about in the world, and there are many appointed angels over them leading them. And there is a great appointed angel over them all on the left side, and that wicked one, Bil'am, was meeting that appointed angel superior to all with his sorceries. And he would say with his sorceries in the night, when he rules with all his company, and he, the appointed angel, would come to meet him and inform him of what he wanted.

Like this example, "And God came to Laban the Aramean," etc.: Like this, "And God came to Laban the Aramean," who is that appointed angel who meets with him. That is, the appointed angel mentioned above, and so also "And God came to Abimelech." They are all like this. In all places they call him with these spells. And therefore, it was more frequent at night than in the day, because night is the time of his dominion. As mentioned above in the close discussion. And they already established it. And all these sorcerers and wise men were for Abimelech, as it is written: "And Abimelech king of the Philistines looked out of the window." It is written here "out of the window" and it is written there "out of the window the mother of Sisera looked and cried." There it was with spells, also here with Abimelech with spells. And therefore, also "And God came to Abimelech" refers to the appointed angel mentioned above who is invoked with spells. Laban had already established that he was a sorcerer, and Balaam was like him. Therefore, the "God" written on them refers to the designated angel.

If so, why...? If so, why is it called the Torah of truth, the perfect Torah of HaShem, the faithful testimony of HaShem, the upright precepts of HaShem, the luminous commandments of HaShem, the pure fear of HaShem, the true judgments of HaShem? And it is written that they are more desirable than gold, and much fine gold, for these are the words of the Torah. But certainly the superior, holy Torah is the Torah of truth, the perfect Torah of HaShem. And each word comes to show superior things, because that story in history comes not only to show about itself, but comes to show about the generality, as we have explained.

Come and see, "and it rested." Come and see: "And the ark rested." This verse is like this, as will be explained, and many others. At the time when judgment hangs over the world and judgments abound, and the Holy One, Blessed Be He, sits on the throne of judgment to judge the world on that throne, how many sentences are inscribed on it! How many decrees of judgments are kept within it, in the King's archive! All the open books are kept there, and that is why nothing is forgotten by the King. And that throne is only prepared and rested on the seventh month, which is the day of judgment, the day when all the inhabitants of the world are reviewed, all pass before that throne. And because of this, "and the ark rested," which is Malchut, called "ark," "in the seventh month." In the seventh month, certainly, which is the judgment of the world.

Upon the mountains of Ararat... Upon the mountains of Ararat: "Ararat" is an expression for "accursed," alluding to those accusers, owners of wailing and screaming, and all the messengers who stand on that day before the Holy One, Blessed be He. And many defenders wake up on that day, and all stand under that throne at the judgment of the world.

And Israel is saved by prayer... And Israel is saved by prayer on that day, and they pray and supplicate before Him, and they blow the shofar, and the Holy One, Blessed be He, has mercy on them and turns judgment into mercy. And all the superiors and inferiors open and say: "Blessed are the people who know the blast of the shofar." And therefore it is necessary on that day that the one who blows knows the beginning of the secret of things and concentrates on the blast, and does the thing with superior wisdom. And therefore it is written: "Blessed is the people who know the blast of the shofar," and it is not written "those who blow the blast of the shofar." And we have already learned: The explanation is that the simple blast indicates kindness, and the alarm blast indicates judgment, and the main intention must be on the alarm blast, which is judgment, to turn judgment into mercy.

They walked all that... They walked all that day. When night fell, they went up to a place and found a cave. Rabbi Elazar said, "Let one enter the cave, if he finds a place there that is better prepared." Rabbi Yosei entered and saw another cave inside and a candlelight shining in it. He heard a voice saying, "When you light the lamps toward the face of the menorah, the seven lamps will shine." Here the assembly of Israel, which is Malchut, took light from the upper Mother, which is Bina, and adorned itself. And all the lamps, which are the sefirot of Malchut, shine in her, from her. And they said about themselves, "Two subtle souls float," that is, they raise MAN with their Torah. And all the friends, that is, all those who raise MAN through their Torah, who are called friends, bind Malchut with the upper one, which is Bina, and from there they extend their illumination downward. "Topsirin" means soul, depending on the context. Or perhaps from the language "Tapsar," which means prince, because the soul rules over the body.

**They hang below Your crown, etc.** Below the crown, golden bells hang all around, a golden bell on this side, and a golden bell on that side, and one pomegranate in the middle. That pomegranate has a thousand bells, and each of those bells blazes in red and in white. That pomegranate is divided into four sections and stays open, so that the bells in it are visible. There are 325 bells on this side, and likewise with all of the sides, such that they light up the four sides of the world from the vision of each and every sections. And they are called the pomegranate split open, as it is written (Song of Songs 4:3), "your brow behind your veil [gleams] like a pomegranate split open."

The explanation: Now the aspect of the end of the crown of Kingship ( Malkhut ) is understood, meaning the aspect of the vessels of its back. And you already know that when Wisdom ( Chokhmah ) is face to face with the Small Face ( Zeir Anpin ) it is only revealed by the vessels of its back (as mentioned earlier in the Introduction to the Book of the Zohar, p. 6, s.v. VeIlmaleh). And the aggregate of the vessels of the back is called pomegranate, by way of the secret of what they said about the verse, "your brow ( rakatekh ) is like a pomegranate split open": That even the empty ones ( rekanim ) among you - meaning the vessels of the back that are judged to be empty in comparison with the vessels of the front - are filled with commandments like a pomegranate, which is full of lights. And this is at the time that they connect with the vessels of the front and hang from them. For they then also receive the enlightenment of the three columns from the vessels of the front; and then the enlightenment divides into right and left and to the secret of the twelve, called bells. And the aggregate of the bells is called pomegranate, since its enlightenment ascends from the bottom to the top.
